summary: The Crunchyroll APK is the Android installer for Crunchyroll, the anime streaming service with simulcasts shortly after Japan, subtitles and dubs. metaDescription: Crunchyroll APK download for Android: get the official Crunchyroll anime app from Google Play, with plans, offline viewing, subs vs dubs and playback fixes.

faq.q: How do I install Crunchyroll on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Crunchyroll and check the developer is Crunchyroll, LLC before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Crunchyroll, LLC and may be altered, so the safest way to use Crunchyroll is the official listing.
Crunchyroll's free tier with ads was reduced, and most of the catalogue now needs a Premium plan. Check the app for what's free in your country.

faq.q: Can I download anime on Crunchyroll?
faq.a: Yes, offline viewing is included with the higher Premium tiers. Tap the download icon next to an episode.
Yes. Many shows have English and other dubs. Change audio and subtitles from the player settings.
